text:
jess_customer: Hi team — our console shows $200 trial credits on project `acme-dev-01` but when we call the API with our service key the usage endpoint shows no credits and calls are being billed. Project: acme-dev-01, org: acme-inc. Can someone investigate?

liz_support: sorry about that — can you confirm the project_id + an example request id and timestamp? also are you using a project-scoped service key or an org-level key? :shield:

jess_customer: project_id is `acme-dev-01`. example request id: `req-0a1b2c3d`. timestamp ~ 2026-02-21T15:12:03Z. we’re using a project-scoped key that was created last week. happy to DM the key if needed (don’t paste full token in channel).

billing-bot: Automatic grant applied: `trial-2026-02-acme` -> org `acme-inc` (visible in Console).

liz_support: thanks. quick triage steps you can run and paste results (no key content) — run: 
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/credits
```
should return JSON with credit buckets and `applied_to` field. also run a usage check: 
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?start=2026-02-20T00:00:00Z&end=2026-02-22T00:00:00Z"
```

jess_customer: pasted DM the key to @liz_support. ran the credits call, response snippet (redacted): 
```json
{ "credits": [], "note": "no project-level credits" }
```
usage call shows charges for tokens (non-zero).

omar_engineer: looking at logs for `req-0a1b2c3d` — request authenticated as project `acme-dev-01` but meter emits `billing_project: acme-dev-01` -> pipeline is firing. I can also see console UI pulling org-level grants `org-credit:trial-2026-02-acme` and showing them on the dashboard, but the billing pipeline expects credits to be attached to the project billing account. Looks like the org->project credit mapping didn't propagate after the org migration last week.

liz_support: tl;dr: console shows org grant, but metering uses project-level assignments. we need to attach the org grant to the project or resync mapping. two options: (1) assign the credit to the project via the public API (safe), or (2) run an internal resync to backfill existing projects. which would you prefer?

jess_customer: prefer (1) for now — less blast radius. do you have the exact command?

omar_engineer: run this (we’ll verify after):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/acme-inc/credits/assign" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"credit_id":"trial-2026-02-acme","project_id":"acme-dev-01"}'
```
Response should be 200 and you’ll start seeing `applied_to: acme-dev-01` in the credits endpoint. Note: replace $ADMIN_TOKEN with an admin token (we can run this for you if you don't have admin rights).

anna_ops: I can run the assign for you at 16:00 UTC unless you want to run it now. If you want us to run it, please confirm and I’ll schedule the internal job and follow up once meter checks are green.

jess_customer: pls run it, we don’t have admin tokens. thanks!

anna_ops: scheduled. running assign now... will post results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

anna_ops: done — API returned 200. credits now show `applied_to: acme-dev-01` in the org credits list. kicking off billing resync for the last 7 days to re-evaluate metering offsets.

liz_support: I see the resync job kicked off (job id `resync-774`). ETA ~ 3 minutes. will verify that future usage is billed against credits and that past usage gets adjusted if applicable.

billing-bot: Billing resync job `resync-774` completed. Adjusted invoices: 1 invoice had pending credit application, status -> adjusted.

jess_customer: verified on our side — usage endpoint now returns credits: 
```json
{ "credits": [{"id":"trial-2026-02-acme","applied_to":"acme-dev-01","remaining":195.42}] }
```
and the recent request `req-0a1b2c3d` shows as covered by credits. huge thanks. :tada:

omar_engineer: great — root cause was migration left org-credit unbound to project billing. we’ve added a monitoring alert to detect org grants without project assignment when migration flag is set.

liz_support: closing loop — if you see any discrepancy in the next 24h ping this thread. thanks for the quick confirmation, @jess_customer :white_check_mark: 

jess_customer: thanks everyone! :pray:
